claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_speed.speedKind: "fall"
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring sets the wearer's fall speed to 60 ft/round. The existing grant_speed atom only covers fly/swim/climb/burrow. Fall is a distinct movement mode in 5e (governed by gravity, not the creature's action) and needs its own speedKind so it can be set independently without touching walking/fly/etc. speeds.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_fall_damage_immunity
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring prevents all damage from falling. Fall damage is bludgeoning in RAW, but grant_damage_immunity{damageType:"bludgeoning"} is dishonestly broad — it would suppress all bludgeoning from attacks, area effects, etc. A source-conditioned immunity atom (or a dedicated grant_fall_damage_immunity atom) is needed to model fall-source-only immunity without contaminating the full bludgeoning immunity space.
